title: Limit Laws for the Distance to Fréchet Means of Random Graphs
summary: This paper investigates the Fréchet mean of the Erdős-Rényi random graph $G_{n,p}$ with respect to the Frobenius distance on graph Laplacians, a metric that captures global structural information beyond local edge flips. We first characterize the Fréchet mean set as consisting of quasi-regular graphs (i.e., graphs where all vertex degrees differ by at most one). We then analyze the asymptotic behavior of the Frobenius distance $F_n=d_{\mathrm{F}}(G_{n,p},R)$ as $n\to\infty$, where $R$ is any Fréchet mean.
